title: Sprint 2: Instantiation engine (bwrk template run)
description: Implement bwrk template run <ref> --var k=v: substitutes named variables into titles/descriptions/labels/acceptance, then executes the work create / dep add / work ready sequence as one ledger-consistent operation. Every created item is labelled with the template id+version and a unique run id; the instantiated root links back to the template and prior runs are discoverable via label/source query. Re-run model is fresh-instance-per-run: closed runs stay closed; runs may overlap.
acceptanceCriteria: template run creates the full structure atomically; partial failure leaves no orphaned records
All created items carry template id+version and run id; root links to template source
Running the same template twice yields two independent instances; prior runs listable
Sprint closed with git checkpoint commit(s) or a no-commit reason code
